name: nefro-m365-console
description: Console de licencas Microsoft 365 - identifica contas ociosas e o custo mensal parado

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:dominio && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run build:dominio && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:dominio && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:dominio && npm run build:pages -w apps/web
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w apps/desktop && npm run start -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run build -w apps/desktop && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
